items.x: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

items.t: Sports betting is increasingly the norm for Gen Z.  Here’s why some financial and mental health experts are worried
items.x: Surveys show Gen Z increasingly views sports bets as a form of investment, and those who gamble too often face mental health risks.
